verdict.rationale: Exa's own Websets and Contents APIs do work across many items at once. A Webset takes a target item count, checks every candidate against criteria and fills enrichment fields for each accepted item, and Contents accepts one or more URLs per request. Community hands-on reports describe low match accuracy and items stuck on 'Verifying...', which weakens confidence in the depth of bulk results but does not show that bulk processing fails to work. Missing for 10: documented bulk management actions (bulk update/delete/re-run across existing items), documented batch sizes or limits, and independent evidence of reliable large-batch performance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: A Webset starts with a natural-language query and a target item count. Add criteria that every result must satisfy and enrichment fields to populate for each accepted item.
it will search, verify each result against your criteria, and enrich every match with additional data you specify.
Pass one or more URLs or document IDs and request highlights for the parts relevant to your task.
Exa Agent is an async, usage-based web research agent API for high-compute tasks like list building, enrichment, and deep research.
